claims.description: fn creates lexical closures: the defining environment is captured, calls get a child scope, def inside a function does not leak to the caller, and let shadows without mutating outer bindings
if, and, or are lazy: the untaken if branch and short-circuited and/or operands are never evaluated, and and/or return the deciding value
evaluating an unbound symbol raises WeftError 'unbound symbol: <name>' carrying that symbol node's line/col
core builtins implement DESIGN.md section 8 exactly: variadic + - * / including unary forms, division by zero raises WeftError, chained number-only comparisons, deep structural = over nested lists

tasks.description: Create src/env.mjs (lookup/define/newGlobalEnv skeleton per DESIGN.md section 6 — newGlobalEnv registers nothing yet but creates __out) and src/evaluator.mjs with evalForm() handling literals, symbol lookup (WFT-09 contract), and the quote special form per section 5 (quote of a symbol yields its name as a string; quote of a list yields an array of quoted items). Tests in tests/eval-core.test.mjs.

Extend src/evaluator.mjs with def, let, do, fn and function application per DESIGN.md section 7: closures capture the defining env, calls bind params in a child env, arity errors use the exact message shape, let binds sequentially, do returns last (empty do is nil). Tests in tests/eval-scope.test.mjs.

Extend src/evaluator.mjs with if, and, or per DESIGN.md section 7, including the truthiness rule of section 5 (only false and nil are falsy). Laziness must be pinned with side-effect probes (e.g. a def in the untaken branch must not run). Tests in tests/eval-branch.test.mjs.

Create src/builtins-core.mjs with + - * / = < > <= >= not per DESIGN.md section 8 (exact error messages; unary - and /; chained comparisons; deep structural =), register them in src/env.mjs newGlobalEnv, and create src/index.mjs exporting tokenize, parse, WeftError, newGlobalEnv, and evaluate(src, env?) per section 9 (run and format come in a later epic). Tests in tests/builtins-core.test.mjs must exercise the builtins THROUGH evaluate().
